websites.summary: We plan, write, design and build your website, including the forms, content tools and connections it needs.
websites.fit: For a new website, a change in direction, or a site your business has outgrown.
websites.firstStep: Send your current URL or the pages you need. We’ll map the work and prepare a quote for the project.
deliverables: Page planning and copy based on your business
Responsive design and development for the pages in your proposal
Enquiries, bookings, content management and required connections
Launch checks, deployment and access to manage the site

ecommerce.summary: We bring your brand, products and shopping experience into a working store, with the connections your team needs to run it.
ecommerce.fit: For a new store, a move to Shopify, or an existing store that needs improvement.
ecommerce.firstStep: Share your current store, product catalog and launch requirements. We’ll define the storefront and operating work to include in the proposal.
deliverables: Brand implementation, plus identity or label design when included
Shopify setup, products, collections and store pages
Buying journeys, subscriptions, upsells and channels your account supports
Inventory, email and SMS connections, with guidance for store operations

software-solutions.summary: We build the product website, customer application and admin tools together, then deploy the frontend and backend and hand over the project.
software-solutions.fit: For a new software product or a business workflow that needs its own application.
software-solutions.firstStep: Send the product idea or show us the workflow you want to replace. We’ll define a first release, its boundaries and the checks for completion.
deliverables: A branded product website with the pages in your proposal
Accounts, onboarding and the main customer workflows
Admin tools, a database, email and required API connections
Frontend and backend deployment, with code and data handover

ai-solutions.summary: We build an agent around a specific task, connect the tools and information it needs, and give your team a way to review its work.
ai-solutions.fit: For a repeated task or product feature that needs an agent connected to real business systems.
ai-solutions.firstStep: Show us the task, a few example inputs and the systems involved. We’ll define the agent’s job, access and how you’ll judge its output.
deliverables: A defined task, sample inputs and checks for a useful result
The agent or team, execution environment and required tool connections
Context, memory, permissions and human review where needed
Evaluation, deployment, operating guidance and ownership handover

agent-teams.summary: We build a manager and specialist agents around one workflow, with shared context, clear handoffs and a review of the combined result.
agent-teams.fit: For a workflow that needs several kinds of work and someone to check how the results fit together.
agent-teams.firstStep: Bring a workflow that moves between people or tools. We’ll map the roles and decide where a coordinated agent team would help.
deliverables: A manager, specialist workers and a way to assign tasks
Shared context, handoff rules and permissions for each role
Review of worker outputs before the result is presented
Deployment, visibility into runs and guidance for the operator

agent-infrastructure.summary: We build or deploy the environment that runs your agent, connects its tools and gives an operator control over tasks, limits and recovery.
agent-infrastructure.fit: For an agent that needs deployment, a custom execution environment, or better operating controls.
agent-infrastructure.firstStep: Share the agent or harness you use, where it needs to run and the tools it must access. We’ll define the deployment or build required.
deliverables: An existing harness configured for your use, or a custom harness
Tool execution, task state and permission controls
Logs, evaluation hooks, usage limits and recovery paths
Deployment configuration and documentation for the operator

jev-implementation.summary: We connect Jev to a specific decision in your application, then define the routes, thresholds and fallback and test them against reviewed examples.
jev-implementation.fit: For repeated routing, classification or evaluation decisions that need defined outputs and fallback behavior.
jev-implementation.firstStep: Show us the repeated decision, sample inputs and what should happen next. We’ll define the integration and the examples needed to evaluate it.
deliverables: A decision schema and a set of realistic test examples
A Jev API or supported LangChain connection in your application or harness
Thresholds, routing branches and fallback behavior
Evaluation results and guidance for maintaining the integration

context-and-memory.summary: We connect your business sources to the agent’s context and memory, with retrieval, updates and access rules built around the information it needs.
context-and-memory.fit: For agents that miss internal information, lose useful context or need the same briefing repeatedly.
context-and-memory.firstStep: Bring the sources your agents should use and questions they struggle to answer. We’ll map the context, retrieval and update requirements.
deliverables: An inventory of sources and a process for bringing them in
A vector database and retrieval where the task needs them
Context storage, access rules and update behavior
Retrieval checks, maintenance guidance and data handover

mcp-and-api.summary: We connect applications and agents to the systems they need through supported integrations, custom MCP servers or APIs.
mcp-and-api.fit: For a missing connection, a private tool that needs an agent interface, or a product that needs an API.
mcp-and-api.firstStep: Send the systems you need to connect and the actions or data that should pass between them. We’ll define the interface and access requirements.
deliverables: The MCP integration, custom server or API in your proposal
Authentication, permissions and documented inputs and outputs
Data mapping, error handling and integration tests
Source or configuration handover with deployment guidance

creative-ai-workflows.summary: We connect the brief, models, review and file delivery into a workflow your team can operate for the media it produces.
creative-ai-workflows.fit: For teams repeating creative production across several tools, formats or review steps.
creative-ai-workflows.firstStep: Share a typical brief, example outputs and the steps your team repeats. We’ll define the generation, review and delivery workflow to build.
deliverables: A workflow for your creative inputs and required formats
Selected model connections and custom generation agents where needed
Brand context, reference handling and human review
File delivery, version tracking and guidance for the operator

ai-setup-and-consulting.summary: We configure your selected AI tools around the work you want to do, connect the agreed context and tools, and walk your team through using them.
ai-setup-and-consulting.fit: For people or teams adopting an AI tool or fixing a setup that does not work as intended.
ai-setup-and-consulting.firstStep: Tell us which tools you use or are considering, and what you want the team to do with them. We’ll define the setup or consultation you need.
deliverables: A setup plan for the chosen product and account
Installation or workspace configuration through the supported route
The agreed context, tools and workflow connections
A walkthrough, usage guidance and configuration handover

brand.summary: We create or apply your visual identity across the agreed channels, with the files, templates and guidance your team needs to use it.
brand.fit: For a brand launch, an identity refresh, or applying an existing identity to a website, store or product.
brand.firstStep: Share your current assets and where the brand needs to appear. We’ll define the identity work, applications and files to include.
deliverables: Brand direction and the visual identity assets in your proposal
Typography, color and guidance on using the identity
Templates and applications for the chosen channels
Organized source files and an implementation handover

unslop.summary: We review the site or content you have, agree what to keep and repair the design, writing or functionality that is letting it down.
unslop.fit: For a website or content that is close, but still feels generic, inconsistent or difficult to use.
unslop.firstStep: Send the site or content and tell us where it falls short. We’ll inspect it and recommend a repair scope, or explain why it needs a rebuild.
deliverables: A review of what to preserve and what needs attention
A representative correction to establish the direction
The design, writing and development repairs in your proposal
Rechecked pages or content, with revised files or the updated site

consultation.summary: We inspect the problem or proposal, compare the practical options and give you a written recommendation with the next steps.
consultation.fit: For a technical decision, an unexplained problem or a proposed build that needs a closer review.
consultation.firstStep: Tell us the decision you face or the problem you need to understand. We’ll agree the review scope and written output before work begins.
deliverables: The questions to answer and an agreed inspection scope
A review of the relevant product, system or documents
Practical options with dependencies and tradeoffs
A written recommendation and prioritized next steps
